scope: Prospective execution allocation for only the remaining24 logical blocks /96 fresh scientific cells. The three already registered full-count pilots /12 cells continue untouched. No new source implementation, experiments or dispatch by this reviewer.
original_goal: Full fresh108-cell, three-app/three-SDK-mode/four-real-runtime-arm/three-repetition study of whether operation models and prospective Bering-to-Sheaft forecasts from missing/incomplete SDK and eBPF evidence are useful against independent external outcomes. All ten operations and adverse/negative/UNKNOWN outcomes remain required. The contribution is not weakened to model flags, a useful demonstration, mathematical novelty, or cost/overhead superiority.
authorization: The user authorized a complete fresh restart and previously requested one agent per runner with maximum standard resources. Changing our execution allocation within that scope, while explicitly disclosing the design amendment, does not require permission for a weaker contribution because the original external feasibility criterion and complete scientific scope are unchanged.
explicit_design_change: Replace within-phase physical-host pairing for the remaining96 with standardized isolated runners assigned through preregistered opaque slots and randomized arm orders. The original12 retain physical pairing. Do not claim unchanged physical pairing or overwrite sealed provenance.
required_invariants: One arm per identically requested standard4CPU/16GB runner; same frozen common blueprint/image identities and guest CPU/RAM/two-kernel settings.
Same preregistered workload seeds, initial-state/reset rules, full counts, deadlines, actual model/forecast/evaluation algorithms and external oracles.
Opaque slot0..3 mapped by the existing preregistered arm_orders. Host assignment must not be selected adaptively by collector, performance, health, forecast support or outcomes.
Record actual host CPU/model/RAM/disk/limits and all preflight/attempt evidence; identical preflight thresholds for all arms.
All four training closures and all four frozen actual model/forecast bundles must precede every fresh validation target. No target refit or screening on accuracy.
Exact per-slot capture/model/validation artifact IDs and actual producing job/run attempt provenance; built-in retry must not silently resolve same-name artifacts from a different attempt.
Include the new active workflow and all actual dependencies in the complete scientific source census/approval binding.
No cancellation, recapture, restart or repeated valid data for the current three pilots; no historical81, short-smoke or auxiliary substitution.
Retain negative, unavailable and UNKNOWN models and all failed/early-stop attempts under existing predeclared technical rules; no retry-until-positive.

required: same-information direct conditional implementation, including known healthy .875/1 forecasts
actual SDK-only/no-eBPF runtime arm with Native views

strongest_equal_information_baselines.knowledge: All methods receive the same declared semantic contracts, inventory and metadata; supplied knowledge cannot be counted as eBPF-discovered improvement.
strongest_equal_information_baselines.outcome: Equal forecasts, availability, ARI and admission flags are not incremental external utility or a new predictor.

causal_and_hardware_assessment: Randomized allocation to standardized independent hosts preserves an interpretable original feasibility study and between-host randomized runtime treatment comparisons. It removes the stronger same-host control and increases variance/finite-sample hardware imbalance risk with only three repetitions. Within-arm Native/direct/cheap-union comparisons still share actual input and outcomes. Hardware covariates document rather than erase residual imbalance. No precise overhead, causal cost advantage, universal product ability/inability or passive-observer claim follows.
allocation_regime_limit: The first12 and remaining96 have different allocation regimes, and that regime is tied to the pilot settings. Report the regime explicitly and do not pool all108 as physically paired or infer an isolated allocation-regime effect.
cost_verdict: Record every actual runner preparation, repeated blueprint download/restore/hash, control/capture/model/forecast, transfer, failed/early-stop attempt, CI, review and retention/archive cost. Count real executions once and do not treat upstream alias job IDs as additional work. Human/unmetered costs remain unknown. Parallel wall-time reduction does not demonstrate lower aggregate CPU/billing/total cost.
resource_verdict: Long elapsed status alone does not prove serial phase-budget failure. This prospective allocation avoids placing four arm captures inside one job deadline, but actual capture/model/validation fit and capacity remain empirical gates; no fit is claimed here.
required_record: ROOT must explicitly amend protocol/allocation provenance before using the new workflow, preserving the original registered pilot bytes and reviews. Separate source/dispatch and actual-result reviews remain required.
changes_by_reviewer: This signed design record only; no experimental source/protocol/registry edits, downloads, jobs or diagnostics.
